```yaml
name: End-to-End Flow Tests

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**"

concurrency:
  group: e2e-flows-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Get pnpm store directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "STORE_PATH=\"$(pnpm store path --silent)\"" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        name: Setup pnpm cache
        with:
          path: ~/.pnpm-store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Setup ngrok tunnel
        uses: ngrok/ngrok-github-action@v3
        with:
          authtoken: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          tunnels: |
            http:3000:3000

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        id: ngrok
        uses: ngrok/ngrok-github-action@v3
        with:
          authtoken: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          tunnels: |
            http:3000:3000

      - name: Setup test environment
        run: |
          echo "NGROK_TUNNEL_URL=${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.url }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres?schema=public" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "AUTH_SECRET=secret" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=client_id" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=client_secret" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=client_id" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET=client_secret" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GOOGLE_PUBSUB_TOPIC_NAME=topic" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SECRET=secret" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SALT=salt" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "INTERNAL_API_KEY=secret" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.url }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "OPENAI_API_KEY=${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GOOGLE_API_KEY=${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "OPENROUTER_API_KEY=${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ env.DATABASE_URL }}
          AUTH_SECRET: ${{ env.AUTH_SECRET }}
          GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID: ${{ env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID }}
          MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          GOOGLE_PUBSUB_TOPIC_NAME: ${{ env.GOOGLE_PUBSUB_TOPIC_NAME }}
          EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SECRET: ${{ env.EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SECRET }}
          EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SALT: ${{ env.EMAIL_ENCRYPT_SALT }}
          INTERNAL_API_KEY: ${{ env.INTERNAL_API_KEY }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: ${{ env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL }}
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          E2E_NGROK_TUNNEL_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_TUNNEL_URL }}

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-flow-test-results
          path: apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/results/
          retention-days: 7
```
